::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 28 1896  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book Hampshire Record Office 70M92W/60/226
:::

Dear Madam
I enclose you a Statement about the fire Insurance shewing which I propose to use. I think this will be sufficient
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)

If you will verify this list or return it to me I will send for a correct copy of the whole as soon as the new Policies are completed

Miss Yonge PTO

P.S.[^1]

I see by the property tax assessment that there are two places apparently occupied by John Price &; that there are 4 other houses put down to you &amp; occupied by Ruddock Davis, Day &amp; Light &amp; a house occupied by Mrs Bishop, making 19 altogether considering Prices as 2 occupations. The names &amp; the assessment are

Holly C Barford
Norgat John Price}
Hayes Do
Mills Mw Mrs Bishop
Rodaway E Ruddock
C Gardner Mrs Davis
C Ray jr Mr Martin Wm Day
Cornelius Cabin Mrs H Light
C Ray Senr

---

[^1]: This letter survives reproduced faintly in a wetpress copy outletter book.  What is evidently the original of this second page of the letter survives in the bundle Hampshire RO MS 67M92W/82/24.  CMY perhaps returned it to him annotated and he used it further as an aide memoire.
